4-islands.title: 4 Islands Tour from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
4-islands.metaDescription: 4 Islands tour from Koh Lanta by longtail or speedboat: Emerald Cave, Koh Ngai, Koh Ma or Kradan. Lunch included. Join-in from 1,000 THB.
4-islands.lead: Koh Chueak, Koh Mook and its Emerald Cave, Koh Ngai, then Koh Ma or Koh Kradan. A full day on the water, by longtail or speedboat, private or join-in.
intro: The 4 Islands sit south of Koh Lanta, in the Trang sea. The longtail route stops at Koh Chueak, Koh Mook, Koh Ngai and Koh Ma. The speedboat route swaps Koh Ma for Koh Kradan. On a private longtail you can add Koh Kradan as a detour.
At Koh Mook you swim through the Emerald Cave and come out in a lagoon enclosed by cliffs. Lunch is a Thai buffet on the beach, on Koh Ngai with the longtail and on Koh Kradan with the speedboat.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel between 7:45 and 8:30, then the pier (the Old Town pier for the longtail, a separate pier for the speedboat).
The boat leaves. The longtail takes about 45 minutes to reach the first island.
Koh Chueak, snorkeling over the reef, about 45 minutes.
Koh Mook, swim through the Emerald Cave to the hidden lagoon.
Lunch buffet on the beach, then swimming and time to do nothing.
One more island and one more snorkeling stop: Koh Ma on the longtail, Koh Ngai on the speedboat.
Back on Koh Lanta between 15:30 and 16:00, transfer to your hotel.

included: Thai buffet lunch on the beach, water and fruit
On a private boat: the boat and the captain for your group only
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash on the island
4-islands.parkFee: 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
goodToKnow: Join-in or private. On a private longtail the schedule is flexible and you choose the order of the islands.
Children have their own rate. Babies under 4 go free on the longtail. Give us the ages when you book.
Times vary a little with the sea and the season. The return is usually between 14:30 and 16:00.

faq.q: Longtail or speedboat for the 4 Islands?
faq.a: The longtail is the traditional wooden boat, slower and open, and it visits Koh Ma. The speedboat is faster and visits Koh Kradan instead. Both include lunch and snorkel gear.
Both exist. You can join a group or take the boat for your group only, with a dedicated captain.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. No operator on Koh Lanta includes it. You pay 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child in cash to the ranger on the island.
Yes. Children pay a child rate and babies under 4 travel free on the longtail. Life jackets are on board. Give us the ages when you book.

koh-rok-koh-haa.title: Koh Rok & Koh Haa Day Trip | Secret Travel & Tour
koh-rok-koh-haa.metaDescription: Koh Rok and Koh Haa from Koh Lanta, October to April, by speedboat or private longtail. Snorkeling and lunch on the beach. Speedboat from 2,000 THB.
koh-rok-koh-haa.lead: Two islands of the Mu Ko Lanta National Park, open from October to April, by speedboat or private longtail. Snorkeling stops and lunch on the beach of Koh Rok.
intro: Koh Rok is two islands, Koh Rok Nok and Koh Rok Nai, about an hour and a half south of Koh Lanta by longtail and less by speedboat. Koh Haa, the Five Islands, has a turquoise lagoon for the last snorkeling stop on the way back.
The park is closed in the rainy season. Tours run from October to April.

day.text: Pickup at your hotel around 8:00, light breakfast at the pier.
The speedboat leaves for Koh Rok.
Two snorkeling stops over the coral around Koh Rok.
Lunch buffet on the beach of Koh Rok, swimming, and the monitor lizards that live on the island.
Koh Haa and a third snorkeling stop in the lagoon.
Back on Koh Lanta around 15:30, at your hotel by 16:30.

included: Thai buffet lunch on the beach, water and fruit
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash on the island
koh-rok-koh-haa.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
goodToKnow: Private longtail option: Koh Rok only, 8:00 to 16:00, about 1h30 each way, your group only.
Private speedboat option: your group only, 9:00 to 16:00.

faq.q: When can you go to Koh Rok?
faq.a: From October to April. The national park closes the islands during the rainy season.

faq.q: How long is the boat ride to Koh Rok?

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child in cash to the ranger on Koh Rok.
The join-in trip is by speedboat and includes Koh Haa. The private longtail goes to Koh Rok only, at your own pace.

koh-phi-phi.title: Koh Phi Phi Day Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel

intro: Phi Phi is north of Koh Lanta. The speedboat crosses in about an hour. The morning is spent around Phi Phi Leh, the island with Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. After lunch on Phi Phi Don, the afternoon goes to Bamboo Island, with snorkeling from the beach.

Crossing to Phi Phi Leh.
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and a snorkeling stop.
Lunch buffet on Phi Phi Don, free time on the beach.
Bamboo Island, swimming and snorkeling from the beach.

Back towards Koh Lanta, at your hotel around 16:30.

mangroves.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour | Secret Travel & Tour
mangroves.metaDescription: Mangrove trips at Thung Yee Peng, Koh Lanta: private raft at sunrise or sunset, longtail or kayak, with monkeys and crabs. Half days from 1,000 THB.
mangroves.lead: The mangrove on the east side of Koh Lanta, by longtail, on a private wooden raft, or by kayak. Half a day, or just a sunrise.
intro: Thung Yee Peng is a village on the east coast of Koh Lanta with a protected mangrove behind it. The channels are calm. You see monkeys, birds and fiddler crabs on the mud at low tide.

Three ways to go. A longtail runs through the main channels. A private wooden raft, poled slowly, leaves from Thung Yee Peng pier for a sunrise, a fishing morning or a dinner at sunset. A kayak gets you into the narrow channels.

day.text: Sunrise raft. On the water by 5:30, sunrise around 6:00 over the mountains, light breakfast on the raft (coffee, tea, snacks), back at the hotel by 7:30.
Fishing raft. Fishing in the waters of Ao Lanta, a look at how the local fishermen work, a seafood lunch cooked on the raft, back around 14:00.
Sunset raft. Sunset on the river, seafood dinner by candlelight, then the bioluminescent plankton in the dark water, back by 20:00.

included: On the raft: breakfast, lunch or dinner depending on the programme, drinks and fruit
Kayaks and life jackets on the kayak trip
goodToKnow: The raft is private, for your group only. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The kayak can be combined with an hour of ATV in the forest, two hours in all.
Bring mosquito repellent for sunrise and sunset.

faq.q: Which mangrove trip should I pick?
faq.a: The raft is the quietest, with the sunrise and the sunset dinner as its two programmes. The kayak is more active and reaches the narrow channels. The longtail is the simplest with children.
On the sunset dinner programme, once it is dark, the plankton lights up when the water moves.

faq.q: How early is the sunrise trip?
faq.a: Pickup is around 4:40 and you are back at the hotel by 7:30, in time for a second breakfast.

scuba-diving.title: Scuba Diving Koh Lanta, Courses and Dives | Secret Travel
scuba-diving.metaDescription: Scuba diving on Koh Lanta: first dive from 4,500 THB, fun dives at Koh Haa and Phi Phi, catamaran trips and SSI courses to Rescue. Small groups, hotel transfer.
scuba-diving.lead: Try diving for a day, or train from your first breath to advanced diver. Small groups, a professional instructor and the reefs of the Andaman Sea.
intro: Nobody needs experience for the one-day Basic Diver. You learn the basics in shallow water, then make two dives with your instructor, never more than two students per instructor. The courses go on from there, up to Advanced Open Water, rescue and specialties, with four students at most per class.
The one-day dives are at Koh Haa or Koh Bida. Every day depends on the weather and the sea, and you follow your instructor's safety instructions from start to finish.

day.text: Kids Scuba Explorer. Two supervised dives to 5 metres, from age 8, with two children per instructor at most. No experience needed.
Basic Diver. Breakfast and a briefing on the basic theory and safety rules, then the equipment and a few skills in shallow water, then two dives to 12 metres. From age 10, no experience needed.

Open Water Diver. The first full certification: digital learning, confined-water training and four open water dives, down to 18 metres with a certified buddy. From age 12. Divers from 10 take the Junior version, to 12 metres.
Advanced Open Water Diver. Five adventure dives to work on buoyancy, navigation and deep diving, down to 30 metres. From age 15, for certified divers. A Junior version, to 21 metres, starts at 12.
React Right. First aid, CPR, oxygen and emergency response, from age 15. It is sold together with the Stress and Rescue Diver course.
Stress and Rescue Diver. Recognising stress, preventing accidents and managing a rescue, with four training dives and four rescue scenarios. From age 15, and the step before Divemaster.
Deep Diver specialty. Five dives: two on a local trip, to 30 metres, then three on a special trip, to 40 metres. From age 15, and it pairs well with Nitrox.
Nitrox specialty. Theory on enriched air, for longer bottom times and less tiredness after the dive. You add it to any day trip, with the Nitrox tanks and the dive computer included. From age 15.
Fun dives for certified divers. Two dives at Koh Haa, or at Phi Phi and Koh Bida, with a maximum of four divers per group. Divers with no dive in the last year take a refresher first.

Special trips by catamaran. Three dives for divers certified to Adventure Diver or Advanced, 30 metres at least, with a last dive within the past six months. The northern trip goes to the Kled Kaeo wreck, Koh Bida and Hin Klai and is back at 4.30 pm. The southern trip goes to Hin Daeng, Hin Muang and Koh Haa and is back at 5 pm.

Snorkelling on the dive boat. Local sites only, for people who would rather stay at the surface while a family member dives. Children under 5 come free, and a nanny stays on board with younger children.

included: Hotel transfer both ways, breakfast, lunch, snacks, fruit and drinks on the day

kayak.title: Kayaking Koh Lanta, Sea Caves and Mangroves | Secret Travel

batik.title: Batik Painting Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
batik.metaDescription: Batik painting on Koh Lanta: morning or afternoon course, or kayak and paint. Hotel transfer and your finished canvas included. Adults 1,500 THB.
batik.lead: Paint your own batik canvas with a local instructor, in the morning or the afternoon, or pair it with a kayak trip to the sea cave of Koh Talabeng.
intro: Batik is a wax-resist technique from Java, recognised by UNESCO in 2009. You draw patterns in wax on fabric before it is coloured. An experienced instructor shows you the tools, the colours and the technique, then you paint what you like.
The canvas is varnished after the class and delivered to you the next day.

day.text: Pickup at 8:00 to 9:00. Introduction to batik at 9:00, then you create your artwork from 10:00 to 12:00. Back at your hotel around 13:00.
Pickup at 12:00 to 13:00. Introduction at 13:00, then you create your artwork from 14:00 to 16:00. Back at your hotel by 17:00.

Pickup at 8:00 to 9:00 for Tungyeepeng pier. A longtail to Koh Talabeng, paddling around the islets, the sea cave and the beach. Lunch at the mangrove restaurant at 12:00, painting from 13:00, back at your hotel at 17:00.

batik.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. For a private course, for your group only, ask us.

goodToKnow: Open all year.

faq.a: Yes. Children from 3 to 10 have their own rate.

Morning or afternoon if you only want to paint. Kayak and painting if you want a day out with the sea cave first.

speedboat.title: Speedboat and Ferry from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
speedboat.metaDescription: Speedboat times from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi, Phuket, Koh Ngai, Mook, Kradan, Lipe and Langkawi, plus Krabi and Ao Nang in season. Hotel pickup on Koh Lanta.
speedboat.lead: Speedboats from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi and Phuket, to the islands of Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Kradan and Koh Lipe, and on to Langkawi. In the high season also to Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay and Koh Yao.
intro: Boats leave from Saladan pier. We book your seat and arrange the hotel pickup on Koh Lanta, at a time that depends on your beach.
Tell us your route, your date and how many of you travel, and we reply with the fare.

day.text: Koh Phi Phi at 9:30, then Phuket (Rassada pier) at 10:30.
Koh Ngai 11:10, Koh Mook 11:20, Koh Kradan 11:35, Koh Bulon 12:35 and Koh Lipe 13:30. From Koh Lipe a ferry goes on to Langkawi, arriving at 18:00 on Malaysian time.
Koh Phi Phi at 13:30, then Phuket at 14:30.

Koh Phi Phi at 15:00, then Phuket at 16:00. From December to April a second boat leaves at the same time for Krabi (15:35), Railay (15:50), Koh Yao Noi (16:15), Koh Yao Yai (16:25) and Ao Nang (16:35, last stretch by shared van).
Koh Ngai 15:40, Koh Mook 15:50 and Koh Kradan 16:10.

goodToKnow: Coming back to Koh Lanta: from Phuket at 8:30, 11:00 and 12:30, with a stop at Phi Phi, arriving at 10:00, 12:30 and 14:00. From Koh Kradan at 10:45 or 12:15 (Koh Mook 11:00 or 12:30, Koh Ngai 11:30 or 12:50), arriving at 12:00 or 13:30.
In high season, from Koh Yao Yai at 8:00, Koh Yao Noi 8:10, Railay 8:35, Ao Nang 7:50 and Krabi 8:50, arriving at Koh Lanta at 10:00.
Check in at the pier 30 minutes before departure, and 1h30 before for Langkawi, for the immigration check.

Times are for the 2026-2027 season and change with the weather and the sea. Some departures run all year, others from 15 October to 30 April. Langkawi runs from 1 November to 15 April, and Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay and Koh Yao from 1 December.

faq.a: Yes, on Koh Lanta. The pickup time depends on your beach and we confirm it when you book.
Yes, from Koh Lanta with a change of boat at Koh Lipe. The day starts at 10:30 and you arrive at 18:00 on Malaysian time.

faq.q: How do I book a seat?
faq.a: Choose speedboat in the form, pick your date and where you go, and send the message on WhatsApp. We reply with the fare.
